Here is the corrected test suite in xUnit Test Cases notation:

```artifact
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
import pytest

class TestController(unittest.TestCase):

    @patch('controller_module')
    def test_meet_commanded_pressure(self, mock_controller):
        # Preconditions
        mock_controller.get_current_pressure.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_commanded_pressure.return_value = 20  # cmH2O

        # Steps
        mock_controller.update_pressure()

        # Expected
        self.assertLessEqual(mock_controller.get_current_pressure.return_value, 20 + 0.8 * 1)  # cmH2O
        self.assertGreaterEqual(mock_controller.get_current_pressure.return_value, 20 - 0.8 * 1)  # cmH2O

    @patch('controller_module')
    def test_meet_commanded_peep(self, mock_controller):
        # Preconditions
        mock_controller.get_current_peep.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_commanded_peep.return_value = 20  # cmH2O

        # Steps
        mock_controller.update_peep()

        # Expected
        self.assertLessEqual(mock_controller.get_current_peep.return_value, 20 + 1 + (20 * 0.1))  # cmH2O
        self.assertGreaterEqual(mock_controller.get_current_peep.return_value, 20 - 1 - (20 * 0.1))  # cmH2O

    @patch('controller_module')
    def test_meet_target_fio2(self, mock_controller):
        # Preconditions
        mock_controller.get_current_fio2.return_value = 0.5
        mock_controller.get_commanded_fio2.return_value = 0.5

        # Steps
        mock_controller.update_fio2()

        # Expected
        self.assertAlmostEqual(mock_controller.get_current_fio2.return_value, mock_controller.get_commanded_fio2.return_value, places=2)

    @patch('controller_module')
    def test_report_fio2(self, mock_controller):
        # Preconditions
        mock_controller.get_current_fio2.return_value = 0.5

        # Steps
        mock_controller.update_fio2()

        # Expected
        self.assertEqual(mock_controller.get_reported_fio2.return_value, mock_controller.get_current_fio2.return_value)

    @patch('controller_module')
    def test_achieve_commanded_values(self, mock_controller):
        # Preconditions
        mock_controller.get_current_pressure.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_commanded_pressure.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_current_peep.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_commanded_peep.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_current_fio2.return_value = 0.5
        mock_controller.get_commanded_fio2.return_value = 0.5

        # Steps
        mock_controller.update_pressure()
        mock_controller.update_peep()
        mock_controller.update_fio2()

        # Expected
        self.assertLessEqual(mock_controller.get_current_pressure.return_value, 20 + 1 + (20 * 0.1))  # cmH2O
        self.assertGreaterEqual(mock_controller.get_current_pressure.return_value, 20 - 1 - (20 * 0.1))  # cmH2O
        self.assertLessEqual(mock_controller.get_current_peep.return_value, 20 + 1 + (20 * 0.1))  # cmH2O
        self.assertGreaterEqual(mock_controller.get_current_peep.return_value, 20 - 1 - (20 * 0.1))  # cmH2O
        self.assertAlmostEqual(mock_controller.get_current_fio2.return_value, mock_controller.get_commanded_fio2.return_value, places=2)

    @patch('controller_module')
    def test_assist_control(self, mock_controller):
        # Preconditions
        mock_controller.get_current_pressure.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_commanded_pressure.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_current_peep.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_commanded_peep.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_current_fio2.return_value = 0.5
        mock_controller.get_commanded_fio2.return_value = 0.5

        # Steps
        mock_controller.update_pressure()
        mock_controller.update_peep()
        mock_controller.update_fio2()

        # Expected
        self.assertTrue(mock_controller.get_assist_control.return_value)

    @patch('controller_module')
    def test_safety_measures(self, mock_controller):
        # Preconditions
        mock_controller.get_current_pressure.return_value = 20  # cmH2O
        mock_controller.get_commanded_pressure.return_value = 100  # cmH2O

        # Steps
        mock_controller.update_pressure()

        # Expected
        self.assertEqual(mock_controller.get_current_pressure.return_value, 20)  # cmH2O

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
